Powered by Reelgood The Pitt Season 2 has thrown cyber threats, SWAT shootings, pub crawlers, motorcycle crashes, and even Baby Jane Doe at the doctors and nurses of the fictional PTMC emergency department. This week’s all new episode of the HBO Max hit will also deal with the literal fallout of that gnarly water slide disaster we saw at the end of last week’s episode. Will Dr. Robby (Noah Wyle) and his staff manage to save the day without sacrificing their last shreds of sanity? You’ll just have to watch The Pitt Season 2 Episode 10 “4 PM” to find out. The Pitt Season 2 takes place about ten months after the harrowing events of Season 1. It’s the Fourth of July, meaning the ED is already dealing with all sorts of holiday-related injuries, but fate has conspired to make the day even more stressful. Dr. Robby is trying to navigate his last shift before he leaves for a three month sabbatical on the road and Dr. Langdon (Patrick Ball) is coincidentally back for his first shift since going to rehab for his benzos addiction. Head charge nurse Dana Evans (Katherine LaNasa) is still dealing with PTSD from her Season 1 assault and new attending Dr. Al-Hashimi (Sepideh Moafi) is keeping some sort of mysterious medical ailment close to her chest. What nightmares will The Pitt spring on its characters next? Here’s everything you need to know to watch the next episode of The Pitt… Photo: HBO Max When Does The Next Episode of The Pitt Come Out? The Pitt Season 2 Episode 10 “4 PM” Release Date: The Pitt Season 2 Episode 10 “4 PM” will premiere on HBO MAX on Thursday, March 12. What Time Is The Pitt On Tonight? The Pitt Season 2 Episode 10 “4 PM” will be streaming tonight, Thursday, March 12, at 9 PM ET (or 6 PM PT) on HBO MAX. Most new episodes of HBO MAX originals now hit the streaming service at 9 PM ET/6 PM PT. Photo: HBO Max How Many Episodes Are in The Pitt? The Pitt Season 2 Episode Guide: There are 15 episodes in total in The Pitt Season 2. New episodes of The Pitt come out on Thursdays between now and April 16. Worried you might miss a single minute of the action? Here’s your guide to when every episode of The Pitt Season 2 is coming out: Season 2 Episode 1 “7 AM”: Thursday, January 8 Season 2 Episode 2 “8 AM”: Thursday, January 15 Season 2 Episode 3 “9 AM”: Thursday, January 22 Season 2 Episode 4 “10 AM”: Thursday, January 29 Season 2 Episode 5 “11 AM”: Thursday, February 5 Season 2 Episode 6 “12 PM”: Thursday, February 12 Season 2 Episode 7 “1 PM”: Thursday, February 19 Season 2 Episode 8 “2 PM”: Thursday, February 26 Season 2 Episode 9 “3 PM”: Thursday, March 5 Season 2 Episode 10 “4 PM”: Thursday, March 12 Season 2 Episode 11 “5 PM”: Thursday, March 19 Season 2 Episode 12 “6 PM”: Thursday, March 26 Season 2 Episode 13 “7 PM”: Thursday, April 2, 9 PM ET Season 2 Episode 14 “8 PM”: Thursday, April 9, 9 PM ET Season 2 Episode 15 “9 PM”: Thursday, April 16, 9 PM ET Photo: HBO Max Will There Be a Third Season of The Pitt? The Pitt Season 3 Release Date: HBO Max has already renewed The Pitt for a third season. The Pitt Season 3 is expected to come out in January 2027. Is There a Trailer for The Pitt Season 2? Yes, there definitely is. You can watch The Pitt Season 2 trailer by scrolling to the top of this page. The Pitt Season 2 Cast Guide: HBO Max’s The Pitt features a massive ensemble cast of actors, some of whom you might already know from projects like ER, Imposters, The Deuce, Chucky, American Vandal, or Star Trek: Picard. Here’s your guide to who’s who on HBO Max’s The Pitt: Noah Wyle as Dr. Michael “Robby” Robinavitch Katherine LaNasa as Dana Evans Sepideh Moafi as Dr. Baran Al-Hashimi Patrick Ball as Dr. Frank Langdon Supriya Ganesh as Dr. Samara Mohan Fiona Dourif as Dr. Cassie McKay Taylor Dearden as Dr. Mel King Isa Briones as Dr. Trinity Santos Gerran Howell as Dr. Dennis Whitaker Shabana Azeez as Victoria Javadi Shawn Hatosy as Dr. Jack Abbot Laëtitia Hollard as Emma Nolan Irene Choi as Joy Kwan Lucas Iverson as James Ogilvie Kristin Villanueva as Princess Amielynn Abellera as Perlah Brandon Mendez Homer as Donnie Alexandra Metz as Dr. Yolanda Garcia Tags HBO Max Noah Wyle The Pitt
